title: Development of a daily predictive model for the exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
summary: A LightGBM model using demographic, spirometry, treatment, claims, weather, pollution and respiratory-virus features predicted daily COPD exacerbation risk from 590 KOCOSS patients (AUC 0.935; F1 0.653). The paper also reports external evaluation in 2,151 KNHANES participants; this is a retrospective prediction result, not prospective clinical benefit. The result remains bounded to the reported datasets and assays.

evidence.ai_role: LightGBM used clinical, claims, weather, air-pollution and respiratory-virus inputs to predict daily COPD exacerbation; separate KNHANES evaluation was weaker than development results.
